concept: 梳子将杀（车对王基本杀法）
question_cn: 车对光杆王，将死的基本方法是：
question_en: In a rook vs. lone king endgame, the basic mating method is:

options.text_cn: 用车封住一排（列），己方王配合，逐步把对方王逼到边线将死
options.text_en: Cut off the king with the rook, then drive it to the edge with king cooperation

options.text_cn: 车和王分开行动，各自追逐对方王
options.text_en: King and rook act independently to chase the enemy king

options.text_cn: 车直接追杀，不需要己方王
options.text_en: Rook chases alone, no need for own king

options.text_cn: 把对方王逼到棋盘中心将死
options.text_en: Drive the enemy king to the center to checkmate

explanation_cn: 车对王的元思维：车负责切断，王负责逼近。二者分工协作，把对方王步步压缩到边线，最终在角落或边线将死。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: rook cuts off, king advances. Together they compress the enemy king to the edge for checkmate.
